description: Live intraday SELL-SIDE read on names you already hold: current-session trend state, hold strength, readiness, maturity-late flag, gap-risk grade, book regime, and watch_flags naming which deterioration conditions are true right now. Up to 10 symbols per call. Reports conditions only; it never reads your entry or size. Paid per call via x402; live intraday data. $0.005 USDC per call (x402).
